name: Managed Deep Agents v0.10: Browser Use and Async Subagents
title: Managed Deep Agents v0.10: Browser Use and Async Subagents
summary: Managed Deep Agents v0.10 adds browser use, so agents can work on sites with no API and hand you the window to sign in, and async subagents for background work.
